title: Classify workload baseline findings
method: Synthetic 40-workload review: 28+5+4+3=40; selected baseline pass=28/40=70%. Categories use first findings and do not establish absence of other risks.
alt: Classify workload baseline findings: Baseline satisfied 28 workloads, Excess privilege 5 workloads, Egress gap 4 workloads, Needs investigation 3 workloads. Illustrative inputs.
